name: Collective Memory
body:
Your recall of seedling history is strong.

Prerequisite: Int 13, Root Memory, seedling.

Benefit: Once per day you may reroll a Knowledge (history) or Knowledge (nature) check and take the better result. You must decide to use this ability before the results of the roll are declared.
